title: NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture: Agent Access Policy Is Not Architecture Governance
description: NVIDIA's OpenShell Reference Architecture can verify agent access policy in five modeled areas. An allowed write can still break an architecture decision.
og_headline: NVIDIA OpenShell: Access Is Not Architecture
og_alt: Editorial card: NVIDIA OpenShell: Access Is Not Architecture. A sandbox policy controls what an agent may touch, not what its changes must respect.

reciprocal.desc: What OpenShell sandbox policy governs, and the architectural decisions it cannot see.
